content.bridge_context: Following 'Three Questions', this story shifts from a king's court to a South Indian household, focusing on the simple yet profound kindness of children.

units.title: Children's Perspective
units.explanation: Children often see situations with more empathy than adults, acting on instinct to help those in need.
units.dual_language_instruction: Discuss how children react to a hungry kitten or a beggar. / चर्चा करें कि बच्चे भूखी बिल्ली या भिखारी के प्रति कैसी प्रतिक्रिया देते हैं।

units.title: Vocabulary of Daily Life
units.explanation: Words like 'scrawny', 'glided', 'muttered' describe physical appearance and actions in a vivid way.
units.dual_language_instruction: Learn words that describe movement and look. / हरकत और दिखावट का वर्णन करने वाले शब्द सीखें।
